subsample_graph: subsample a graph around a given paper ID from the MAG dataset using BFS and CSR matrices
get_or_sample_row: get or sample a row of neighbours from a CSR matrix for a given node ID
get_neighbours: fetch edge indices from one node to a corresponding neighbour type in the MAG graph
get_senders: get sender features from given neighbours based on neighbour type and paper features
make_edge_type_feature: create a 7-dimensional one-hot edge type feature vector from node and neighbour types
